scope: Only this original zero-user-argument CALL to the unchanged normal Q.EndSepia C binding
preconditions: The original Q.EndSepia lookup still denotes the registered C closure (function TValue tag 6, C flag nonzero).
The selected original Lua CALL B=1 is executed with a valid ordinary Lua frame.
No enabled debug hook changes the frame/top/callee. Fresh native state sets hook mask to zero; later mutation is not excluded.
Any required allocation returns normally through the ordinary allocator with valid retained stack content. Allocation failure/stack error is not a successful call.
No runtime replacement of the native callback slot, allocator, bytecode, globals, or corrupt memory is claimed by this static contract.

proof_steps.claim: GETGLOBAL Q; GETTABLE EndSepia; CALL A=0 B=1 C=1; zero user args, zero requested results.
B=1 sets L.top=ra+16; ra is the callee TValue, then passes ra and L to precall.
Original callee is tag6/C closure. C path sets ci.func=ra, ci.base=ra+16 and ci.top=L.top+320; it does not append user args or change L.top on the no-growth/no-hook path.

Stack growth relocates top and frame addresses by the same old-stack/new-stack displacement. CI growth relocates CallInfo only. Default allocator reaches KERNEL32.HeapReAlloc; normal successful growth preserves the referenced callee value. No broad allocator/error-handler certification.
Closure passes the same L to marshaller without adding Lua values.
Index -1 resolves to L.top-16=callee. Tag6 is neither number3 nor string4, therefore the explicit default branch pushes native integer0.
Native function writes FE36D4=4, sets FE36DC bit1 if absent and writes the supplied zero to FE36D8 on both flag branches.

new_authoring_policy: REQUIRE_ONE_EXPLICIT_INTEGER; original special-case compatibility does not relax exact arity
general_missing_argument_policy: UNKNOWN_UNLESS_SPECIFIC_FRAME_PROOF; never equate arbitrary missing args to nil
